title: My LLM might Mimic AAE - But When Should it?

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation by Black American annotators comparing LLM-generated African American English (AAE) and Mainstream U.S. English (MUSE) against human baselines to assess coherence, authenticity, and the appropriate presence of AAE linguistic features.

Survey and human annotation using Likert scales to determine if LLM-generated African American English is perceived by Black Americans as 'Black sounding', 'White sounding', stereotyping, offensive, or mocking towards Black Americans.
